column1: # §7.6 Power / exponent — Unicode superscript digits or ASCII ^n after a
# bare number or a single Latin/Greek-letter variable; always "hoch n".
# Superscripts glued to a CLDR unit symbol (m², km², cm³) are Measure's
# own compound unit names, not this class — see measure_scientific.tsv.
# extrapolated: negative exponent on a variable
# negative: already resolved by Measure via the CLDR compound unit name,
# negative: charge notation is Chemical formula, not Power
# extrapolated: bare superscript with no operand on either side is left
# untouched — the gate needs a number or single-letter base
